For an even cheaper option, try the Claude Kiro edition claude-sonnet-5-rp.

【有梗】Gemini 3.8 Flash 酒馆版：有梗、会撩、接梗多。平时 5~10 秒回复（整段一次出来），高峰期偶尔会慢一些。Gemini 对敏感内容管得比较严，这类剧情建议换 grok-4.5。 | [Witty] Gemini 3.8 Flash, roleplay edition: witty and flirty with lots of comebacks. Usually 5-10s per reply (arrives all at once), sometimes slower at peak times. Gemini is strict about sensitive content; switch to grok-4.5 for that.
Claude Opus 4.6，Opus 4 系列版本，推理与代码能力可靠。 | Claude Opus 4.6, an Opus 4 release with reliable reasoning and coding.

Gemini 4 Hydrogen 按次版：每次 $0.004，长短一个价，出字快（一般 2～5 秒），长文也能写完整。在 Gemini 按次组可用。 | Gemini 4 Hydrogen per-request: $0.004 per request regardless of length, fast output (usually 2-5 s), finishes long texts. Available in the Gemini Per-Request group.
